item.title: Lopez Paradise Homestay
item.description: Homestay in Kasarkoda, Honnavar, with 7 air-conditioned rooms, on-site private parking, free Wi-Fi, and complimentary fresh home-cooked breakfast. Nearby: Kasarkod Eco Beach (3.4 km), Sharavathi Kandla Mangrove Boardwalk (3.4 km by car / 2.6 km by bike), Sharavathi Backwater Boating (2.1 km).
